title: Affine pure-dimensional smooth members from an interpolating fixed system
statement:
Let k be algebraically closed, X smooth connected affine finite type over k of
pure dimension d>=2, S a nonempty finite set of closed points and U=X minus S.
For f:Y->Spec k and j:X->Y over k, take an invertible module M on Y and a finite
family s, with the concrete maps of [def-zl-prescribed-point-system-data]. Assume
its combinations vanish on S, its restriction to U generates and defines an
immersion, and its simultaneous first-order map is surjective. Then there is a
nonempty open of affine coefficient space all of whose k-points give smooth affine
members of pure dimension d-1 containing S and having nonzero jets at every point
of S. No high-degree construction or basis property is assumed or concluded.

source.place: Proof paragraph 2: nonzero section, Cartier property, affineness and purity

proof.text: Use the fixed-system Bertini open to obtain smoothness and nonzero jets.

Smoothness gives regularity; finite type gives local Noetherianity. Connectedness then makes X integral. A nonzero jet at a point of the nonempty set S implies that the section and its morphism from the structure module are nonzero. The existing zero-locus theorem gives an effective Cartier divisor.
The componentwise Cartier-purity theorem gives pure dimension d-1. The member is affine because it is closed in affine X.
Residue-fibre vanishing means the points do not belong to the nonvanishing locus. Identify this locus with the complement of the zero-scheme support to obtain containment of S.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_open_smooth_prescribedPoint_member
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsAffine X] [ConnectedSpace X]
    [Smooth (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hdim : X.IsPureDimension d)
    (S : Finset X) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hclosed : ∀ x ∈ S, IsClosed ({x} : Set X))
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (j : X ⟶ Y)
    (hover : j ≫ f = X ↘ Spec (.of k))
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] [((tensorPullback j).obj M).IsInvertible]
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U ↔ x ∉ S)
    {I : Type u} [Fintype I] (s : I → Γ(M, ⊤))
    (hvan : ∀ a : I → k, prescribedPointVanishes ((tensorPullback j).obj M) S
      (tensorSectionsUnit j M (prescribedPointCombination f M s a)))
    (hgen : ∃ ht : Epi ((((tensorPullback (U.ι ≫ j)).obj M).freeHomEquiv).symm
        (prescribedPointRestrictedFamily M j U s)),
      @IsImmersion U.toScheme _
        (@ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections I inferInstance U.toScheme
          (Spec (.of k)) (U.ι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)))
          ((tensorPullback (U.ι ≫ j)).obj M)
          ((invertible_pullback_tensor (U.ι ≫ j)).1 M).2
          (prescribedPointRestrictedFamily M j U s) ht))
    (hjet : Function.Surjective (fun a : I → k ↦ fun x : S ↦
      prescribedPointJet ((tensorPullback j).obj M) x.val
        (tensorSectionsUnit j M (prescribedPointCombination f M s a)))) :
    ∃ O : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial I k))).Opens,
      (O : Set (Spec (CommRingCat.of (MvPolynomial I k)))).Nonempty ∧
      ∀ a : I → k, Set.range (bertiniCoefficientPoint (k := k) a) ⊆ (O : Set _) →
        Smooth ((prescribedPointMember f j M s a).subschemeι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) ∧
        IsAffine (prescribedPointMember f j M s a).subscheme ∧
        (prescribedPointMember f j M s a).subscheme.IsPureDimension (d - 1) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ S, x ∈ (prescribedPointMember f j M s a).support) ∧
        ∀ x ∈ S, prescribedPointJet ((tensorPullback j).obj M) x
          (tensorSectionsUnit j M (prescribedPointCombination f M s a)) ≠ 0
